# OR-Library assignment problems

J. E. Beasley, OR-Library, <https://people.brunel.ac.uk/~mastjjb/jeb/orlib/assigninfo.html>,
retrieved 2026-10-09. From J. E. Beasley, "Linear programming on Cray
supercomputers", Journal of the Operational Research Society 41 (1990) 133-139.
`assignopt.txt` gives each problem's optimal value.
